title: Standard Traits
summary: Core traits in std for conversions, defaults, comparison, and operators.
lecture: Rust uses standard library traits to integrate custom types with language features.
Traits like From, Into, and Default manage safe type creation and conversion.
Comparison and operator traits like PartialEq and Add enable clean syntax for domain types.

example.code:
let s: String = "hello".into();
let d = u32::default();
example.caption: Standard traits enable idiom reuse.
